# Notification Decisions Note 4

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that notification handling of mute interacts with webhook; teams noted that deliverability depends on preference and template, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that notification handling of subscriber interacts with push; teams noted that inbox depends on retrypolicy and digestcadence, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that notification handling of digest interacts with bounce; teams noted that opt-in depends on channel and suppression, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, notification handling of escalation interacts with delivery; teams noted that deeplink depends on fanout and quiethours, especially under real production load.
